t: Debugging Rich Library HTML Export: Performance and Theming in AI-Assisted Development
s: This article details debugging regressions in the `pipulate` project's AI-assisted development workflow, specifically focusing on issues with `rich` library HTML export for DOM hierarchy and layout boxes. The core problem stems from incorrect handling of console objects for text vs. HTML exports, leading to empty HTML files and text files polluted with color codes.
sub: Gemini CLI and Git for regression analysis
